title: S106 later notes: compact fit-test, pane and cue edge cases, tokens line

sections.heading: Why
sections.body:
Later notes from the S106 relay (run-20261026-134141-a7c2, landed f5a2769), not fixed in that slice:
- Fit-test for the compact layout: switch by whether the row fits instead of the fixed 100-column threshold (owner kept 100 for S106, fit-test later).
- The A2 fallback pane lands between a Ready row and its commands when the run has left the snapshot.
- The sidebar Running entry can still hide a stall cue at 80x24; when room fits the bar but not the cue, neither shows.
- No golden with three or more Needs you rows and the pane open at 80x24.
- S66 hit-testing must allow for the inline pane.
- An empty "tokens - $-" line shows for a running step.
- The detail footer wraps mid-phrase (predates S106).
- The Questions-tab title test calls paneLines directly instead of rendering the view.
- `internal/tui/follow_test.go` changed in S106 round 3 but was not in its Files list.
Cross-references: S101 (run id already dropped below 100 columns), S130 (pane height now documented in docs/dashboard.md), S145 (Running rows at a glance; touches the same rows).

sections.heading: Implement
sections.body: Triage first: some notes may be folded into S145 or S101. Spec each kept note with a failing test before building.

sections.heading: Check
sections.body:
- go test -race -count=1 ./...
- go vet ./...
- gofmt -l .
- slicer check
